spells.name: Seedflare
spells.description: An ember carried through the grove. Q fires a seed of light that bursts against an enemy or wall.

spells.name: Rootward
spells.description: The old oath made tangible. R raises bark armor for 2.5 seconds, reducing incoming damage.

spells.name: Bloomstep
spells.description: The garden remembers your footsteps. F makes an extended invulnerable dash along your facing, stopping at solid terrain.
